summary: Geo-swap for promoted engineer: consolidate service accounts, transfer laptop ownership, and temporary cross-org access
description:
Issue summary:
A senior backend engineer (Marcus Valdez) has accepted an internal promotion and will be moving from the US engineering org (us-east) to the EU platform team (eu-west). This ticket coordinates: (1) consolidation/transfer of service accounts and CI access, (2) reassignment and logistics for the company laptop, and (3) short-term cross-org access policy and KMS considerations for encrypted repos and secrets.

Impact:
- Marcus requires continued access to a handful of critical CI pipelines and two internal repos for a 2-week handover window.
- The assigned company laptop is encrypted under the us-east KMS key and needs to be rewrapped or escrowed for EU key management if required by EU team policy.
- There is potential for duplicate service accounts and conflicting SSH keys if we create new EU-scoped accounts without consolidating existing ones.

Background / Constraints:
- Promotion effective date: 2026-03-01 (first EU working day 2026-03-02).
- Marcus will be onboarded to EU Okta groups, but SCIM provisioning is batched nightly and may lag.
- EU security policy favors local KMS key control for certain secrets; currently a small set of repos are encrypted (repo-encrypt-commons).
- Marcus requests to keep his laptop (company asset) and avoid immediate wipe since he needs working state to perform knowledge transfer.

Requested outcome / Acceptance criteria:
- Service accounts used by Marcus are consolidated (no duplicate privileged accounts) and ownership transfer is documented.
- Temporary dual access policy granted for exactly 14 days and auto-revoked.
- Laptop re-encryption / escrow approach defined and scheduled; secure interim measure put in place if KMS rewrap cannot be completed before 2026-03-05.
- Any billing/license transfers (JetBrains, Figma, etc.) documented and initiated by IT.

Immediate actions taken so far:
- HR notified and added to EU onboarding queue (ticket HR-2318).
- Device-ops confirmed current laptop serial and asset tag: SN-XL1298; recorded in asset inventory.
- SCIM logs show Marcus is queued for eu-west groups but not yet present.

Required next steps (owners):
- IAM (Aisha) to audit Marcus-related service accounts, identify duplicates, and propose consolidation plan.
- Device-ops (Samir) to propose re-encryption or escrow plan and schedule physical handoff or remote wipe window.
- Security (Lena) to approve 14-day temporary cross-org access window and sign off on KMS interim measure.
- HR to confirm license transfer or reimbursement processes for paid tools.

Notes on policy question:
- Is it acceptable per company policy to allow a promoted employee to retain an encrypted company laptop while cross-provisioned across org boundaries for a limited grace period? If so, what controls (MFA, disk encryption, remote-wipe timer) are mandatory?

Attachments:
- Asset inventory export (asset_csv_id: A-2026-02-25-117)
- SCIM provisioning logs excerpt (attached)
comments: 2026-02-26 - Riley Chen (Reporter): Opening ticket — outlined business need and requested temporary access. Added HR and device-ops to watchers.

2026-02-26 - Aisha Kapoor (Assignee): I will start by listing all service accounts Marcus owns and mark which are CI-critical. Planning a meeting with Samir and Lena today 15:00 PT to align on KMS and laptop policies.

2026-02-27 - Samir Rahman (device-ops): Confirmed laptop SN-XL1298 is encrypted with alias kms://us-east/redwood-devices. Proposed interim approach: keep current encryption, enforce Intune compliance and require remote-wipe token scheduled for 2026-03-16 unless rewrap completed. Will need security sign-off.

2026-03-01 - Lena Ortiz (Security): Preliminary approval for 14-day cross-org access with conditions: (1) mandatory hardware-based MFA for Okta, (2) remote-wipe token enabled, (3) scope-limited service account roles verified. Security will join final checklist review.

2026-03-02 - Aisha Kapoor: IAM audit in progress. Found two service accounts: svc-ci-runner (owner: marcus.v) and svc-legacy-deploy (owner: marcus.v). svc-ci-runner has elevated write perms to deploy; proposing transfer of owner to eu-platform-admins and keeping svc-legacy-deploy disabled for 7 days then archived. Draft PR to update ownership sent: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123

2026-03-03 - Riley Chen: HR confirmed JetBrains license transfer will be processed by 2026-03-05; Figma transfer requires manual reassignment and will be completed by EU design lead. Added ticket link HR-2318 to comments.
investigation_notes: IAM audit findings (Aisha, 2026-03-02): Marcus is direct owner of 6 low-priv repos and 2 high-priv service accounts. No active SSH key anomalies found on his GitHub profile. SCIM provisioning batch lag is expected; workarounds considered: temporary Okta SCIM override (requires SCIM admin approval) or short-lived IAM role. Device-ops notes: current KMS alias in us-east prevents simple rewrap; we can either re-encrypt with eu-west key (requires key policy change and cross-account decrypt/re-encrypt) or escrow disk image to HSM for EU keying. Security recommends escrow if rewrap cannot be completed without downtime.
resolution: Work in progress. Agreed interim plan (03/02): grant Marcus a time-limited cross-org role valid 2026-03-02 through 2026-03-15 with least privilege; schedule a rewrap attempt for 2026-03-04 (device-ops + security). If rewrap fails, escrow image to secure EU HSM and issue replacement laptop to EU team. Ownership transfer PR (infra#4123) submitted to change svc-ci-runner owner to eu-platform-admins; merge pending 2i review. HR will complete JetBrains/Figma license reassignment by 2026-03-05. Post-action items: runbook update for geo-swap transitions and a checklist for future promotions with cross-region moves.
